scenarios.title: Search asset by partial asset name
preconditions: Enterprise Data Catalog application is open
Catalog contains default test assets including 'Customer Master'
steps: Navigate to the asset catalog page
Enter 'Customer' into the search input field
Execute search
scenarios.expectedResult: 'Customer Master' asset is displayed in the search results.

scenarios.title: Search asset by partial owner name
preconditions: Enterprise Data Catalog application is open
Catalog contains asset 'Sales Transactions' owned by 'Finance Data'
steps: Navigate to the asset catalog page
Enter 'Finance' into the search input field
Execute search
scenarios.expectedResult: 'Sales Transactions' asset owned by 'Finance Data' is displayed in the search results.

scenarios.title: Case-insensitive asset search
preconditions: Enterprise Data Catalog application is open
steps: Navigate to the asset catalog page
Enter 'product reference' in lowercase into the search field
Execute search
scenarios.expectedResult: 'Product Reference API' is successfully matched and displayed.

scenarios.title: Filter assets by asset type API
preconditions: Enterprise Data Catalog application is open
steps: Navigate to the asset catalog page
Select 'API' from the asset type filter
scenarios.expectedResult: Only assets of type 'API' (such as 'Product Reference API') are displayed.

scenarios.title: Clear active asset type filters
preconditions: Enterprise Data Catalog application is open
steps: Observe filtered list showing only File assets
Click the 'Clear Filters' button
scenarios.expectedResult: All active filters are cleared and all default assets (Table, API, File) are displayed.

scenarios.title: View asset details
preconditions: Enterprise Data Catalog application is open
Asset 'Customer Master' is displayed in the asset list
steps: Locate 'Customer Master' in the catalog list
Click on 'Customer Master' asset item
scenarios.expectedResult: The detailed view for 'Customer Master' asset is displayed.

scenarios.title: Search for non-existent asset or owner name
preconditions: Enterprise Data Catalog application is open
steps: Navigate to the asset catalog page
Enter 'UnknownAsset999' into the search input field
Execute search
scenarios.expectedResult: No assets are displayed and a 'No results found' message is shown.

scenarios.title: Search with leading and trailing whitespace
preconditions: Enterprise Data Catalog application is open
steps: Navigate to the asset catalog page
Enter '   Supplier   ' with spaces into the search field
Execute search
scenarios.expectedResult: Leading and trailing whitespace is ignored/trimmed, displaying 'Supplier Data Feed'.

scenarios.title: Reset filtered asset view using 'All' type filter
preconditions: Enterprise Data Catalog application is open
Asset type filter 'Table' is currently selected
steps: Navigate to the asset type filter options
Select 'All' from the filter list
scenarios.expectedResult: The filter resets to show all asset types (Table, API, File).
